# Oliveseeds Creative Studio

Oliveseeds Creative Studio is a premium design and manufacturing studio specializing in physical custom products and digital creative services.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.oliveseedsdesignstudio.com/)
- [Physical Products Catalog](https://www.oliveseedsdesignstudio.com/products)
- [Digital Assets Catalog](https://www.oliveseedsdesignstudio.com/digital)
- [Creative Services](https://www.oliveseedsdesignstudio.com/service)
- [About the Studio](https://www.oliveseedsdesignstudio.com/about)
- [Contact Us](https://www.oliveseedsdesignstudio.com/contact)

## 1. Physical Custom Products
- Customized Laser Engravings (Acrylic panels, wooden keepsakes, metal keyrings)
- Personalised Gifting Solutions (Corporate gifts, custom carvings, luxury plaques)
- Precision wood and acrylic crafting

## 2. Digital & Creative Services
- Brand Identity & Graphic Design
- Website Development & UI/UX Systems (Vite, React, next.js projects)
- Figma UI Kits, Design Packs, and Etsy templates

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React SPA served with dynamic metadata injection
- Backend: Express API + MySQL database
- Integrations: Razorpay (India), PayPal (International), Shiprocket (Logistics)
